question: Does balanced default-versus-finalist confirmation improve the original selection on the captured MLP fixture?
scope: One admission and eight fresh timing processes on the qualified H100 NVL; original and hypothetical choices scored on the same retained post-confirmation graphs.

fixture.selection: Prespecified first-layer MLP down projection from the same checkpoint and exact prior 144 input token IDs, before observing any tuning or execution timing. Verify actual dimensions and capture provenance.
fixture.source: Dense BF16 reference forward with actual captured post-nonlinearity activation; benchmark uses static per-tensor FP8 weights/activations through the SGLang linear facade.

protocol.rule: median(log(explicit/default))<0 chooses explicit, otherwise default; no margin.
protocol.profile_objective: Original auto/synthetic objective, no explicit measurement policy; original initializer without extra clone/copy.
protocol.retained_graph_score: Both original and hypothetical choices use the same two graphs after confirmation; this is not an end-to-end deployed policy comparison.

interpretation.finding: Confirmation corrected one slower explicit choice and introduced none; seven original choices already used default. The geometric mean hypothetical graph benefit is 0.83%, but its exploratory whole-process 95% interval reaches parity.
interpretation.specific_case: Block 5 originally measured explicit at 9.5648 us versus default 10.1984 us (6.21% apparent advantage), then confirmation and held-out graph replay favored default. The explicit graph was 6.90% slower; switching that case gives a 6.46% same-graph counterfactual reduction.
interpretation.additional_insight: The observed incorrect original winner was not merely a sub-1% profiling win. A small arbitrary winning margin would not have prevented this case. This does not identify noise, warming/history, inputs or objective as the cause.
interpretation.decision: Stop this bounded confirmation checkpoint as promising but inconclusive. Do not open a production selection PR or change SGLang policy from this evidence.

evidence.archive_publication: All 9 worker results and traces retained; only unrelated bootstrap import labels omitted from public inventories. Original private native/fixture payloads remain preserved in full raw.

resources.preallocation_recovery: Home quota stopped initial snapshot upload before allocation. Removed exactly two SHA-matched duplicate generated packs while retaining their local copies/metadata; no raw evidence removed. Receipt preserved.

limits: Both choices use common post-confirmation graphs, not untouched versus modified startup.

Slow-choice counts use the measured faster of two graphs without a margin; they are descriptive, not per-process significance or a full candidate oracle.
One fixture/device/time window; one corrected case is too little evidence for a robust production selection rule.
No v1 comparison arm ran here, and no serving-throughput or eager-performance claim is made.
Original live/file caches were preserved; this experiment does not implement or validate persistence of a newly published confirmation winner.
